## Changes
- **Bigger, transparent header logo** – the ArrHub logo in the header is now as tall as the title and version number together and has no dark background, so it sits directly on the header in every theme. The app icon and favicon keep their background so they stay visible on home screens and browser tabs.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.10.3   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.10.2...v1.10.3
